Description

Technology demonstrations and commercial payloads.

Hypernova, will validate its plasma electric propulsion system in orbit, aboard space data services provider EnduroSat’s Platform-2.

Magdrive's first space flight "Operation Get It Up" was successfully launched today aboard SpaceX transporter 6 with Endurosat!
